description: This PHP source file manages the web UI for LAN Ethernet settings on a gateway device, including displaying Ethernet port statuses and enabling/disabling a special port configuration for XFINITY HOME integration.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines if Ethernet port 4 is enabled for XFINITY HOME network based on device configuration.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Maps device status strings to user-friendly labels (e.g., 'Up' to 'Active').
